SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE

Riverside Hospital outpatient endoscopy unit (fictional)
Endoscopic ultrasound report

Patient: Morgan Tremblay (fictional)
Synthetic record: SYN-GI-4013
Date of procedure: 2026-10-21
Place of service: 22
Endosonographer: Dr. Ana Lucia Prieto, MD (fictional)

Procedure
Upper EUS with EUS-guided fine needle biopsy (FNB).

Indications
A 2.4 cm pancreatic head mass on CT; tissue diagnosis and staging.

Technique
The linear echoendoscope was passed through the mouth and advanced to the second part of the duodenum. The pancreas was examined from the duodenum and the stomach.

Findings
A 24 mm by 21 mm hypoechoic, irregular pancreatic head mass was seen abutting but not invading the portal vein. The pancreatic duct upstream measured 5 mm. The common bile duct measured 7 mm.
EUS-guided fine needle biopsy of the pancreatic head mass was performed with a 22-gauge needle; three passes were made and material was sent for histology.
No peripancreatic lymph nodes or ascites were seen.

Impression
Pancreatic head mass, sampled by EUS-guided FNB.

Recommendations
Await histology. Discuss at the multidisciplinary pancreas conference.
